definitions.gloss: empty seat; vacant seat; unoccupied seat
definitions.explanation: A seat that is not occupied, available for use.
Figuratively, an unfilled position or opening, such as in an organization or committee.

examples.japanese: {空席|くうせき}はありますか。
{空席|くうせき}が{見|み}つかったら{座|すわ}ってください。
examples.english: Please sit down if you find an empty seat.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}に{空席|くうせき}があるか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked if there were any available seats on the flight.

examples.japanese: {委員会|いいんかい}に{空席|くうせき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: A vacancy appeared on the committee.

examples.japanese: {役員|やくいん}の{空席|くうせき}を{埋|う}める{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to fill the vacancy among the board members.

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}による{空席|くうせき}の{補充|ほじゅう}はまだ{決|き}まっていない。
examples.english: The filling of the vacancy caused by the retirement has not been decided yet.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{空|くう} (empty, vacant) + {席|せき} (seat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{空席|くうせき}がある - there is an empty seat
・{空席|くうせき}を{探|さが}す - to look for an empty seat
・{空席|くうせき}{待|ま}ち - waiting for a seat/vacancy
・{空席|くうせき}{状況|じょうきょう} - seat availability

ANTONYM:
・{満席|まんせき} - fully booked, no seats available

RELATED WORDS:
・{空|あ}き{席|せき} - empty seat (same meaning, different reading)
・{空|あ}き - vacancy, opening
・{欠員|けついん} - vacancy (in personnel)
